name: CTF to mne/raw
summary: Converts MEG CTF data to MNE Raw (fif)
description: Copies the CTF .ds folder to a temporary location, reads it with mne.io.read_raw_ctf, detects events, marks strictly flat channels and user-listed channels as bad, sets EOG/ECG/MISC channel types, and saves raw.fif with an HTML QC report and a PSD plot. Use it as the first step to bring CTF MEG recordings into MNE-based brainlife pipelines. The eeg parameter is not read by the code.

inputs.description: CTF MEG .ds recording folder with its BIDS headshape, channels, coordsystem and events sidecars.

outputs.description: MNE Raw data in FIF format

parameters.description: EOG channels if any. Default is None.
ECG channels if any. default is None.
Names of channels or list of indices that should be designated MISC channels. Default is None.
Mark flat channels as bad if True (default).
Not read by the code (main.py handles eog, ecg, misc, bads and rm_flat only).

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21, 809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
